episode_title: Leveraging Incremental Improvement for Major Gains with Alex Nottingham

real_qa.q: How much monthly revenue do dental practices lose from missed phone call conversions on average?
real_qa.r: According to the ADA, the average new patient value for the first year is $642. The average office receives 135 new patient opportunities per month, but only one third book appointments (87 calls). This results in over $55,000 of missed revenue per month. With incremental improvement of just one additional converted call per working day, practices can gain approximately $120,000 annually ($10,000 per month multiplied by 12 months).
real_qa.requete: dental practice missed phone calls revenue loss

real_qa.q: What is the All Star Dental Academy business growth formula for doubling a dental practice?
real_qa.r: According to the business growth formula, there are four ways to make money: marketing to make the phone ring, converting the phone call, ensuring the patient shows up, and getting them to refer. If you improve each of these areas by 5% incrementally, you will grow your business 40%. If you can improve each area by 12%, you will double your business. This concept is based on Kaizen, the Japanese principle of growth through incremental improvement.
real_qa.requete: All Star Dental Academy business growth formula

guest.bio_context: Alex Nottingham is a former Tony Robbins top coach and consultant who has worked with companies ranging from one million to one hundred million dollars in revenue. He holds a Juris Doctor (JD) and an MBA from Florida International University. He authored the dental practice book Dental Practice Excellence and co-wrote a best-selling book with Brian Tracy, and lectures nationally and internationally to prestigious dental organizations.
